Easy-to-learn, Arcade-style Drifting Game:

PROS:
(1) Replayability: once you start drifting, you can keep going, non-stop for hours.
(2) You can set up your car to focus on either drifting or racing (time trial).
(3) Multiplayer can be fun, especially when all of you are drifting in the same line. 

CONS:
(1) Graphics and soundtrack are NOT at par with Forza or Gran Turismo.
(2) There are NO official car manufacturers.
(3) There are NOT enough tracks.

RATING:
7/10 - I bought this game at full price for 12 euros but I suggest you buy this on sale for 6 euros.

Самый лучший дрифт симулятор.
CarX drift racing online - симулятор который реально затягивает. Разнообразие карт, автомобилей и тюнинга.
